verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an inference server, for example a batch API or bulk model management, but the evidence documents no bulk or batch capability. PRELOAD_MODELS only accepts a JSON list of models to install at startup. That is a startup configuration setting, not a user-facing bulk operation across items, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
